attributes.title: AAPP 2027 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Annual Meeting of the American Association of Psychiatric Pharmacists (AAPP, formerly CPNP) runs April 4 to 7, 2027, at The Galt House Hotel in Louisville, Kentucky, with a virtual option that streams sessions live. It is aimed at psychiatric pharmacists and other clinicians who treat patients with psychiatric and neurologic disorders.

AAPP, an ACPE-accredited provider, says the meeting will offer 20+ contact hours of knowledge- and application-based CE, plus 10 hours of dually accredited ACPE and BCPP recertification content through the separately sold Clinical Application Series. The posted schedule includes sessions on difficult-to-treat panic disorder, behavioral symptoms of dementia, mood stabilizers, antipsychotic pharmacogenomics, substance-related psychosis, involuntary commitment and new medications.

AAPP lists anticipated rates: in-person registration is $799 for members and $1,065 for nonmembers until March 4, 2027, then $920 and $1,190. The Galt House group rate is $239 per night until March 11, 2027.
